trending.title: Enhance IAM Identity Center with a decentralized permission management to adhere organizational responsibilities at scale

The article covers virtual spaces, delegated permissions, API governance, quota enforcement, backpressure, and support for multiple Identity Center instances | Co-authors: Elias Abud, Eya Abdelmoula, and Philipp Schäfer

trending.title: Where is the Docker Image? Packaging the Official AWS Emulator
trending.description: AWS recently announced the official AWS Emulator, but with one glaring omission: there is no pre-built container image on Docker Hub, GitHub Container Registry, or Amazon ECR Public. Instead, developers are instructed to download an RPM and build their own image. I packaged the emulator into an automated, multi-arch container ( linux/amd64  and  linux/arm64 ) and published it across GHCR, ECR Public, and Docker Hub with automated weekly updates. You can pull and run it immediately.

trending.title: What Werner Wore: The Watches of re:Invent
trending.description: For fourteen years Werner Vogels closed re:Invent with his keynote, and while everyone was listening to him, I spent an evening looking at his wrist. From a bronze IWC Big Pilot and a Breitling Transocean to Panerai, Timex, Armani, Garmin and Samsung, this is a year-by-year look at the watches he wore on stage from 2012 to 2025, what is inside them, and what this mix of Swiss mechanics, simple quartz and smartwatches tells about the engineer who chose them.
